title: Quarterly roadmap tiling and initiative traceability for Hosted API + Model Catalog
creator: Priya Narang
description:
Objective: Produce a tiled quarterly roadmap artifact and traceability matrix that maps every Hosted API + Model Catalog initiative to OKRs, cross-team owners, release lanes, and gating criteria. Scope includes aligning downstream launch readiness (console, docs, SDKs), defining rollback/partial-launch policies for model swaps, and producing a stakeholder-ready deck and machine-readable CSV for integration with the roadmap tracker.

Why this ticket: The product portfolio has grown fragmented across multiple initiative documents. Engineering and GTM teams need a single, queryable source of truth per quarter to reduce misaligned rollouts, avoid duplicate QA effort, and clarify capacity hedges for hosted endpoints.

Deliverables:
- Tiled roadmap artifact (CSV + PNG) showing initiative tiles by week and by dependency lane.
- Initiative-to-OKR traceability matrix (CSV) with fields: initiative_id, owner, OKR_id, priority, release_lane, canary_window, rollback_policy, validation_prompt_set, customer_cohorts.
- Stakeholder slide deck for Exec + Eng sync (10 slides).
- Playbook snippet for on-call and SRE describing fallback routing and capacity hedge triggers.
- Integration stub for roadmap tracker showing automated ingestion of the CSV.

Out-of-scope: Detailed engineering task breakdowns, deep runbook steps for each model (those live in ENG tickets).
success_metrics: >95% OKR coverage for Hosted API initiatives (initiative -> OKR link present)
All critical initiatives have owner and release lane assigned by due_date
Roadmap deck approved by PM + Eng leads within 2 review cycles
CSV ingested automatically into the tracker with zero schema errors
acceptance_criteria: Tiled roadmap artifact uploaded to Drive and referenced in the quarterly kickoff
Traceability matrix contains no empty owner cells for P0/P1 initiatives
Playbook snippet validated by SRE and linked from the release checklist
Integration stub creates a new roadmap entry with correct fields in staging tracker
risks: Late inputs from model onboarding teams causing tile drift
Unresolved capacity assumptions from infra delaying release_lane assignments
Stakeholder misalignment on canary windows leading to rework
updates: 2026-03-01: Kickoff meeting held with Eng, Design, SRE. Initial tile template agreed.
2026-03-05: Received draft OKR mappings from growth and product strategy; two initiatives flagged for re-prioritization.

notes: Design constraint: tiles must render legibly at 16-week zoom and single-quarter zoom levels.
Suggested cadence: weekly sync for first two weeks of cycle to lock owners and release lanes.
Fallback policy templates pulled from SRE repo; customize for each initiative during handoff.
